pluginDescription: Independently toggleable desktop and mobile enhancements for SiYuan; every setting item can be enabled, disabled, hidden and reset on its own.
panel.none: No feature in this category yet
panel.allHidden: Every feature in this category is hidden in feature-control.json
panel.hint: Changes are saved immediately. Toggle or hide a feature in feature-control.json at the repository root, then reload the plugin.
panel.readonlyTip: SiYuan is in read-only or publish mode, so settings cannot be changed here.
config.resetTip: Delete this feature's JSON file and restore the default values.
config.resetDone: Reset done; the JSON file has been removed.
dev.exportAllTip: Save the current configuration of every feature as a JSON file.
dev.dumpRegistryTip: Print each feature's category, control state and mount status to the console.
dev.logLimitTip: Maximum number of entries printed at once.
dev.debugLogTip: Print extra diagnostics to the console while the plugin runs.
dev.dumped: Registry snapshot printed to the console.
feature.functionDemo.name: Example: top bar shortcut
feature.functionDemo.desc: Registers a plugin command and a top bar button to verify the end-to-end chain: control manifest, config file, settings panel and cleanup.
feature.uiDemo.name: Example: injected CSS
feature.uiDemo.desc: Injects a namespaced stylesheet without touching core DOM, to verify reversible CSS-based interface features.
feature.devDemo.name: Example: developer tools
feature.devDemo.desc: Configuration export, registry diagnostics and logging controls for development.
uiDemo.active: The example stylesheet is active on the document tree.
uiDemo.disabledHint: The example stylesheet is disabled in the plugin settings.
functionDemo.disabledHint: The example behaviour is disabled in the plugin settings.
